description: PRMT-offload s==8 rotl(a): SHF->PRMT port. ALU-pipe bound (ncu 96.7% ALU, IPC 2.06=GA10x int32 half-rate cap, PRMT idle) but no gain (-0.6%, noise); ptxas already near-roofline (rotl(c,10) fused to LEA, 1 add/step offloaded to IMAD/FMA)

IMAD-offload post-rotate add (a+=e -> mad.lo x1) to idle FMA pipe. selftest PASS (value-identical a*1+e) but primary 2392 vs 14164 = -83% CATASTROPHIC: 159 asm-volatile IMAD barriers serialize the two independent lines, killing the ILP ptxas relies on (throughput->latency bound). Confirms ptxas already balances IMAD offload optimally; FMA-offload lever is net-negative. m6000 at ALU-roofline (memory: 96.7% ALU, FMA idle 0.6B); PRMT exhausted (only s==8 byte-aligned). 2nd principled discard.

Interleave the two independent 80-step RIPEMD-160 lines step-by-step (a1..e1 with a2..e2) to expose 2-way ILP and fill ALU-pipe bubbles. Value-identical (selftest PASS). Result 14213.5 vs 14163.9 baseline = +0.35%, within 1-2% noise. Confirms ptxas already free-schedules the single straight-line basic block (cross-warp latency hiding at 64.6% occ already keeps the ALU pipe fed at 96.7%); source reordering is ptxas-invariant. 3rd principled discard -> m6000 at ALU/INT32 half-rate roofline (IPC 2.06 = GA10x hardware cap). Levers exhausted: PRMT-offload (-0.6%), FMA-offload volatile (-83%), ILP interleave (+0.35% noise).

Reassociate RIPEMD160 vector STEP add-tree into a single funnel-shift expr (a + f + (x+K), s)+e, grouping x+K off the a-dependency chain. Value-identical (int add assoc mod 2^32, selftest PASS). 14172.3 vs 14163.9 baseline = +0.06%, pure noise. ptxas is INVARIANT to add-tree source structure (already free-reassociates the 4-input sum + funnel-shift), complementing exp #3 (line-ordering invariance). 4th principled discard. Confirms m6000 at GA10x INT32 half-rate roofline (ncu 96.7% ALU, IPC 2.06): per-step ops (1 LOP3 f, IADD3 a+x+K, IADD +f, IADD +e, 2x SHF) already minimal; K=0 rounds + zero msg words const-fold; PRMT exhausted (only s==8 byte-aligned, exp#2). Levers closed: PRMT-offload, FMA-offload, ILP-interleave, add-tree reassoc.

ROOFLINE CONFIRMATION (no edit; control re-measure of clean baseline = 14156.5 vs 14163.9 recorded, -0.05% noise, selftest PASS). 5th round closing the lever space after 4 principled discards (PRMT-offload -0.6%, FMA-offload-volatile -83%, ILP-interleave +0.35%, add-tree-reassoc +0.06%). New analysis this round: (1) PRMT genuinely exhausted -- RIPEMD160 uses 5 distinct rotate amounts {5,6,7,8,9,11,12,13,14,15}x16 each, ONLY s==8 is byte-aligned (already tried), and c=rotl(c,10) is non-byte-aligned so no rotate can move to the PRMT port. (2) Rotate-elimination of the 160 c=rotl(c,10) ops is provably NOT net-positive: each of the 5 registers gets +10 rotation exactly once per 5-step group (uniform only at group boundaries), so within a group the f(b,c,d) inputs carry different accumulated offsets -- eliminating the c-rotate forces up to 2 alignment-rotates back onto the f-inputs => no op reduction. (3) HARD architectural ceiling: modular 32-bit ADD/XOR/SHF cannot execute on GA10x FP32-only units, pinning every int op to the half-rate FP32+INT datapath (IPC 2.06 cap, ncu 96.7% ALU per memory); ptxas already offloads ~1 add/step to the idle FMA/IMAD pipe and const-folds round-1 K=0 + IV step-0. No untried lever with positive EV remains; RIPEMD160 m6000 is at the GA10x INT32 half-rate roofline.

ROOFLINE RE-CONFIRMATION #6 (no edit; clean HEAD re-measure = 14164.6 vs 14163.9 recorded baseline, +0.05% noise, selftest PASS). New rigorous contribution this round: PROVED c=rotl(c,10) is irreducibly 1-rotate/step via value-lifetime trace through the barrel b->c->d->e->a: the rotl-10 is applied exactly once per value (on the c->d transition), so at every step f(b,c,d) reads b,c at rotation-offset 0 but d at offset 10 -- the 3 f-inputs NEVER share a common offset, hence the rotate cannot be factored out of f, deferred, or moved to any other slot without adding an equal-count realignment rotate (formalizes round-5 sketch). Also CLOSED the residual PRMT question empirically: RIPEMD160 S-amounts are {5,6,7,8,9,11,12,13,14,15} -- ONLY s==8 is byte-aligned (already tried exp#1, -0.6%), there are NO s==16/24 rotates, so PRMT port is fully exhausted. All 5 boolean funcs (F/G/H/I/J) are single-LOP3 floor; adds IADD3-packed + IMAD-balanced by ptxas (FMA-offload exp#2 = -83% catastrophic). ALU-bound 96.7% (IPC 2.06 = GA10x INT32 half-rate cap) => occupancy/register levers moot. Levers exhausted: PRMT, FMA-offload, ILP-interleave, add-reassoc, rotate-elim. m6000 firmly at GA10x INT32 half-rate roofline.
